tuition_by_country.notes_it: Pubbliche gratuite per tutti (solo contributo semestrale 150-400). Tasse extra-UE solo in alcuni Land (Baden-Wurttemberg 3000/anno; TUM fino a 6000 triennale/12000 magistrale); altrove 0.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Public universities free for all (only 150-400 semester fee). Non-EU fees only in some Laender (Baden-Wurttemberg 3000/yr; TUM up to 6000 BSc/12000 MSc); elsewhere 0.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tariffe nazionali. UE: licence 178, master 254. Extra-UE tariffa differenziata licence 2895, master 3941 (molti atenei la riducono alla tariffa UE).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: National rates. EU licence 178, master 254. Non-EU differentiated licence 2895, master 3941 (many universities waive to the EU rate).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tasse basate su ISEE: esenzione fino a ISEE 22.000-30.000, poi progressive fino a circa 4000/anno. Stesso schema per UE ed extra-UE (chi non presenta ISEE paga la fascia massima).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Income-based (ISEE): full exemption up to ISEE 22,000-30,000, then progressive up to ~4000/yr. Same for EU and non-EU (no ISEE = top band).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tassa statutaria UE 2601/anno (2025-26). Extra-UE: tassa istituzionale per ateneo/programma (triennale ~9000-22000, magistrale ~12000-37500).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Statutory EU fee 2601/yr (2025-26). Non-EU institutional fee (BSc ~9000-22000, MSc ~12000-37500).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Fiandre (KU Leuven) UE 1157; comunita francese (ULB/UCLouvain) ~835. Extra-UE 9494 (Fiandre).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Flanders (KU Leuven) EU 1157; French community (ULB/UCLouvain) ~835. Non-EU 9494 (Flanders).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Per credito ECTS, prezzo pubblico fissato dalla regione (~60 ECTS/anno). Extra-UE non residenti spesso pagano una fascia/sovrapprezzo piu alto.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Per ECTS credit, public price set by region (~60 ECTS/yr). Non-EU non-residents often pay a higher band/surcharge.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE gratis entro la durata standard (solo contributo OH 25/semestre). Extra-UE 726,72/semestre = 1453/anno.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA free within standard duration (only OH fee 25/semester). Non-EU 726.72/semester = 1453/yr.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: ETH/EPFL. La distinzione non e la nazionalita ma dove e stato ottenuto il titolo d'accesso: chi l'ha preso all'estero paga la tariffa tripla (~4690 EUR) da autunno 2025; chi in CH ~1560 EUR.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: ETH/EPFL. Fee depends not on nationality but where the entrance qualification was obtained: foreign-qualified pay the threefold fee (~4690 EUR) from autumn 2025; CH-qualified ~1560 EUR.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE gratis. Extra-UE pagano (per programma): triennale ~7500-16000, magistrale ~9000-25500 EUR/anno + 900 SEK domanda.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA free. Non-EU pay (per programme): BSc ~7500-16000, MSc ~9000-25500 EUR/yr + 900 SEK application.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE gratis. Extra-UE ~10000-17000 EUR per 60 ECTS/anno (per programma).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA free. Non-EU ~10000-17000 EUR per 60 ECTS/yr (per programme).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE gratis, e gratis per chi studia in finlandese/svedese. Extra-UE in inglese: triennale 13000, magistrale 13000-18000.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA free, also free in Finnish/Swedish. Non-EU English-taught: BSc 13000, MSc 13000-18000.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE triennale: solo Student Contribution ~3000 (tasse coperte dallo Stato). Magistrale UE a pagamento. Extra-UE tariffa piena.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU undergrad: only ~3000 Student Contribution (State pays tuition). EU master fee-paying. Non-EU full tuition.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE gratis nei corsi in polacco. Corsi in inglese a pagamento anche per UE (1500-4200). Extra-UE in polacco 5250/anno.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU free in Polish-taught programmes. English-taught paid (even for EU, 1500-4200). Non-EU Polish-taught 5250/yr.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Corsi in ceco gratis per tutti (UE ed extra-UE). Corsi in inglese a pagamento (es. medicina in inglese 24250/anno).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Czech-taught free for everyone (EU and non-EU). English-taught paid (e.g. medicine in English 24250/yr).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE: propina nazionale ~697/anno (Univ. Lisbona). Extra-UE tariffa internazionale fissata dall'ateneo (~3000-7000).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU: national propina ~697/yr (Univ. Lisbon). Non-EU international rate set by university (~3000-7000).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tetto triennale home (Inghilterra) GBP 9535 (~11200 EUR). Post-Brexit gli studenti UE pagano le tariffe internazionali. Magistrale e internazionali non hanno tetto (fissate dall'ateneo). Scozia gratis per scozzesi.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: England home undergrad cap GBP 9535 (~11200 EUR). Post-Brexit EU students pay international rates. Master and international fees uncapped (provider-set). Scotland free for Scots.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE/Svizzera gratis (solo tassa semestrale ~85). Extra-UE pagano dal 2023 (~11000-33000/anno, per ateneo).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA/Swiss free (only ~85 semester fee). Non-EU pay since 2023 (~11000-33000/yr, per institution).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Pubbliche senza tasse: solo quota di iscrizione annuale ISK 75000 (~530 EUR) per tutte le nazionalita.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Public universities no tuition: only ISK 75,000/yr registration fee (~530 EUR) for all nationalities.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE/SEE gratis (primo ciclo). Extra-UE 1080/semestre (1360 per scienze/ingegneria); magistrale fino a ~11000.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU/EEA free (first cycle). Non-EU 1080/semester (1360 science/engineering); master up to ~11000.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Triennale UE 3417 (pagata dallo Stato); extra-UE 6834. Magistrale a pagamento per tutti (4100-10250).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Bachelor EU 3417 (state-paid); non-EU 6834. Master fee-paying for all (4100-10250).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Stesse tasse per tutti: triennale ~400/anno. Magistrale 0-5200 (un master specialistico fino a 24000).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Same fees for all: bachelor ~400/yr. Master 0-5200 (one specialised master up to 24000).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Triennale pubblica in greco gratis per tutti. Magistrale e programmi in inglese a pagamento (1500-9000, indicativo).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Public undergrad in Greek free for all. Master and English-taught programmes charge fees (1500-9000, indicative).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti finanziati dallo Stato gratis; gli altri pagano tasse fissate dall'ateneo (non pubblicate centralmente). Tariffe extra-UE non disponibili da fonte ufficiale.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-funded places free; others pay HEI-set fees (not centrally published). Non-EU figures not available from an authoritative source.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti con borsa statale gratis; posti a pagamento fissati dall'ateneo. Extra-UE ~3000-5000 triennale, 4000-6000 magistrale, medicina fino a 16000 (indicativo da portali).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-scholarship places free; self-financed places HEI-set. Non-EU ~3000-5000 BSc, 4000-6000 MSc, medicine up to 16000 (indicative, portals).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tutti pagano (tariffe fissate dal Consiglio dei Ministri) salvo posti protetti. UE ~300-1700, extra-UE ~1750-3850 (medicina 4000-7700), indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: All pay (Council of Ministers rates) except protected places. EU ~300-1700, non-EU ~1750-3850 (medicine 4000-7700), indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tempo pieno in slovacco gratis per tutti (anche internazionali). A pagamento solo part-time, fuori durata o corsi in lingua straniera (tetto 2725/anno).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Full-time in Slovak free for all (incl. international). Fees only for part-time, over-duration or foreign-language programmes (cap 2725/yr).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Maggioranza degli studenti UE su posti finanziati = gratis. Extra-UE per campo: 1000-10400 (medicina 10000-12000), indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Most EU students on state-funded places = free. Non-EU by field: 1000-10400 (medicine 10000-12000), indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: UE gratis (programmi accreditati a tempo pieno). Extra-UE 2000-11000 triennale, 2000-15000 magistrale, indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: EU free (full-time accredited programmes). Non-EU 2000-11000 BSc, 2000-15000 MSc, indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: In estone a tempo pieno gratis. Programmi in lingua straniera a pagamento (tetto per credito 50/100/120 EUR); internazionali 1500-15000, indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Estonian-language full-time free. Foreign-language programmes paid (per-ECTS caps 50/100/120 EUR); international 1500-15000, indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti finanziati dallo Stato gratis; gli altri pagano. Internazionali 1550-15000 (odontoiatria 15000, Executive MBA 25600), indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-funded places free; others pay. International 1550-15000 (dentistry 15000, Executive MBA 25600), indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti finanziati dallo Stato gratis (solo ~50 EUR domanda). Internazionali 1000-5300 triennale, 2200-6500 magistrale (medicina >10000), indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-funded places free (only ~50 EUR admission). International 1000-5300 BSc, 2200-6500 MSc (medicine >10000), indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti budget statali gratis (anche per stranieri via quota federale). A pagamento ~120000-600000 RUB/anno (~1300-6500 EUR), indicativo.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State budget places free (incl. international via federal quota). Paid ~120000-600000 RUB/yr (~1300-6500 EUR), indicative.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti statali per ucraini; altrimenti a contratto. Internazionali per campo: ingegneria 1200-4000, medicina 1500-5000, MBA 2000-6000 (indicativo). Verificare stato atenei (guerra).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State places for Ukrainians; otherwise contract. International by field: engineering 1200-4000, medicine 1500-5000, MBA 2000-6000 (indicative). Verify university status (wartime).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti budget per bielorussi; a pagamento da ~2500 USD/anno (~2300 EUR), minimo, per ateneo (indicativo).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Budget places for Belarusians; paid from ~2500 USD/yr (~2300 EUR) minimum, per institution (indicative).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti budget per moldavi; altrimenti a contratto. Esempio medicina (USMF) 3150-7800; non-medico ~1400-2800 (indicativo da portali).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Budget places for Moldovans; otherwise contract. Medicine (USMF) 3150-7800; non-medical ~1400-2800 (indicative, portals).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti budget (budzet) gratis; autofinanziati pagano tariffe della facolta. Internazionali ~1000-7000/anno (indicativo, portale ufficiale).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-subsidised (budzet) places free; self-financing pay faculty fees. International ~1000-7000/yr (indicative, official portal).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Sistema decentrato (entita/cantoni), nessuna tariffa nazionale. Internazionali ~2000-6000 (indicativo, non verificato su fonte ufficiale).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Decentralized system (entities/cantons), no national tariff. International ~2000-6000 (indicative, not verified on official source).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tasse nazionali basse per albanesi. Internazionali ~1500-4000 (indicativo, solo portali terzi).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Low national fees for Albanians. International ~1500-4000 (indicative, third-party portals only).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti finanziati + autofinanziati. Nessuna cifra ufficiale reperita (verificare ukim.edu.mk).
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-funded + self-financing places. No authoritative figure found (check ukim.edu.mk).

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Posti finanziati gratis. Internazionali ~1000-3000 (indicativo, portali terzi). Usa EUR.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: State-funded places free. International ~1000-3000 (indicative, third-party portals). Uses EUR.

tuition_by_country.notes_it: Tasse nominali per kosovari. Internazionali da ~1000 USD/anno (~950 EUR), indicativo. Usa EUR.
tuition_by_country.notes_en: Nominal fees for Kosovars. International from ~1000 USD/yr (~950 EUR), indicative. Uses EUR.

scholarships.name: Erasmus+ Mobility Grant (study abroad)
scholarships.provider: European Commission / Erasmus+
scholarships.coverage_en: Monthly grant approx. EUR 200-500 for 3-12 months abroad plus tuition-fee exemption at the host institution; top-ups for students with fewer opportunities.
scholarships.coverage_it: Contributo mensile ~200-500 EUR per 3-12 mesi all'estero + esenzione tasse nell'ateneo ospitante.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Students enrolled at a higher education institution holding an Erasmus Charter, doing a study period at a partner institution abroad.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti iscritti a un ateneo con Carta Erasmus, per un periodo di studio presso un partner all'estero.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarship
scholarships.provider: European Commission / Erasmus+
scholarships.coverage_en: Full scholarship: EU contribution EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months, plus travel, installation and participation costs including health insurance.
scholarships.coverage_it: Borsa completa: 1.400 EUR/mese fino a 24 mesi + viaggio, installazione e assicurazione.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Students worldwide holding a first degree, admitted to an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master delivered by a consortium in at least three countries.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti di tutto il mondo con una prima laurea, ammessi a un master congiunto Erasmus Mundus in almeno tre paesi.

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarships
scholarships.provider: DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service)
scholarships.coverage_en: Monthly stipend (e.g. EUR 992 students, EUR 1,300 doctoral) plus flat-rate travel allowance; not repayable.
scholarships.coverage_it: Stipendio mensile (es. 992 EUR studenti, 1.300 dottorandi) + viaggio forfettario; non rimborsabile.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Primarily international graduates, doctoral students and postdocs for study/research in Germany.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Laureati internazionali, dottorandi e postdoc per studio/ricerca in Germania.

scholarships.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
scholarships.coverage_en: Monthly stipend EUR 2,100 (from Jan 2026) plus international transport, insurance, housing search and cultural activities; tuition exemption for national diplomas at public institutions.
scholarships.coverage_it: Stipendio 2.100 EUR/mese (dal 2026) + trasporto, assicurazione, alloggio; esenzione tasse nei diplomi nazionali pubblici.
scholarships.eligibility_en: International (non-French) students nominated by a French institution for a master's or PhD.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti internazionali (non francesi) nominati da un ateneo francese per master o dottorato.

scholarships.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
scholarships.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI), ICE, Uni-Italia
scholarships.coverage_en: Full tuition exemption plus EUR 10,000 stipend disbursed quarterly.
scholarships.coverage_it: Esenzione totale tasse + 10.000 EUR di stipendio (trimestrale).
scholarships.eligibility_en: Citizens of eligible listed countries, for English-taught master's in engineering, architecture/design, economics/management.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Cittadini di paesi idonei, per master in inglese in ingegneria, architettura/design, economia/management.

scholarships.name: DSU regional scholarship (Diritto allo Studio Universitario)
scholarships.provider: Italian regional DSU agencies
scholarships.coverage_en: Means-tested (ISEE): tuition exemption, accommodation, meals and annual cash grant; varies by region/income.
scholarships.coverage_it: Su base ISEE: esenzione tasse, alloggio, mensa e contributo annuale; varia per regione/reddito.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Enrolled students (Italian and international, incl. non-EU) below regional income/asset thresholds.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti iscritti (italiani e internazionali, anche extra-UE) sotto le soglie regionali di reddito.

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education / Nuffic and participating institutions
scholarships.coverage_en: One-time EUR 5,000 paid in the first year.
scholarships.coverage_it: Una tantum 5.000 EUR nel primo anno.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Non-EEA international students enrolling in a bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti internazionali extra-SEE iscritti a triennale o magistrale in un ateneo olandese aderente.

scholarships.name: Orange Tulip Scholarship (OTS)
scholarships.provider: Nuffic Neso offices with participating institutions
scholarships.coverage_en: Awards varying by university, from partial tuition waivers to full tuition, some with living allowance.
scholarships.coverage_it: Premi variabili per ateneo: da esenzioni parziali a copertura totale delle tasse, alcuni con indennita.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Citizens of specific Neso countries admitted to a participating Dutch programme.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Cittadini di specifici paesi Neso ammessi a un programma olandese aderente.

scholarships.name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships
scholarships.provider: VLIR-UOS (Flemish Interuniversity Council)
scholarships.coverage_en: Covers tuition, travel, insurance and living expenses for the full programme.
scholarships.coverage_it: Copre tasse, viaggio, assicurazione e spese di vitto e alloggio per l'intero programma.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Applicants from 29 eligible developing countries admitted to selected English-taught Flemish programmes.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Candidati da 29 paesi in via di sviluppo ammessi a programmi in inglese delle Fiandre.

scholarships.name: ARES Scholarships
scholarships.provider: ARES (Wallonia-Brussels Federation)
scholarships.coverage_en: Covers tuition, international travel, subsistence allowance, registration, visa and insurance.
scholarships.coverage_it: Copre tasse, viaggio internazionale, indennita di sussistenza, iscrizione, visto e assicurazione.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Residents/professionals of eligible partner countries for advanced bachelor/master or continuing education.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Residenti/professionisti di paesi partner per master avanzati o formazione continua.

scholarships.name: MAEC-AECID Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)
scholarships.coverage_en: Depending on call: monthly stipend (~EUR 1,200), tuition contribution, travel and insurance.
scholarships.coverage_it: A seconda del bando: stipendio mensile (~1.200 EUR), contributo tasse, viaggio e assicurazione.
scholarships.eligibility_en: International and Spanish graduates, mostly postgraduate; some calls target developing countries.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Laureati internazionali e spagnoli, soprattutto post-laurea; alcuni bandi per paesi in via di sviluppo.

scholarships.name: Ernst Mach Grant
scholarships.provider: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
scholarships.coverage_en: Monthly grant plus insurance and travel/installation support, depending on variant.
scholarships.coverage_it: Contributo mensile + assicurazione e supporto viaggio/installazione, secondo la variante.
scholarships.eligibility_en: PhD students, postgraduates, postdocs and young lecturers from foreign universities for short stays (not full degree).
scholarships.eligibility_it: Dottorandi, post-laurea, postdoc e giovani docenti esteri per soggiorni brevi (non laurea intera).

scholarships.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Swiss Confederation / SERI
scholarships.coverage_en: Funded scholarship for research or study at Swiss universities/federal institutes; benefits vary by country/type.
scholarships.coverage_it: Borsa per ricerca o studio in atenei svizzeri; benefici variabili per paese/tipo.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Early-career researchers from ~180 countries with a master's, with a confirmed Swiss host supervisor.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Ricercatori a inizio carriera da ~180 paesi con master, con un supervisore ospitante svizzero confermato.

scholarships.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
scholarships.provider: Swedish Institute (SI)
scholarships.coverage_en: Full tuition, monthly living stipend SEK 12,000, travel grant SEK 15,000, medical insurance, SI network.
scholarships.coverage_it: Tasse complete, stipendio SEK 12.000/mese, viaggio SEK 15.000, assicurazione medica, network SI.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Citizens of listed eligible countries with work/leadership experience, admitted to an eligible English-taught master's.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Cittadini di paesi idonei con esperienza lavorativa, ammessi a un master idoneo in inglese.

scholarships.name: Danish Government Scholarships under the Cultural Agreements
scholarships.provider: Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science
scholarships.coverage_en: Covers tuition and a monthly grant ~DKK 6,090 (before tax) towards living costs.
scholarships.coverage_it: Copre tasse + contributo mensile ~DKK 6.090 (lordo) per le spese di vita.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Highly qualified master's/PhD exchange students from eligible countries (Europe, China, Japan, Israel, Egypt, Russia).
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti master/PhD molto qualificati in scambio da paesi idonei (Europa, Cina, Giappone, Israele, Egitto, Russia).

scholarships.name: University tuition-fee scholarships / waivers
scholarships.provider: Individual Finnish universities (no national government scholarship)
scholarships.coverage_en: Tuition waivers 50-100%; some include relocation/living grant (e.g. University of Helsinki 100% waiver + EUR 5,000 relocation grant).
scholarships.coverage_it: Esenzioni tasse 50-100%; alcune con contributo di trasferimento (es. Univ. Helsinki esenzione 100% + 5.000 EUR).
scholarships.eligibility_en: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying students admitted to an English-taught programme; via the programme application.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti extra-UE/SEE paganti, ammessi a un programma in inglese; tramite la domanda al programma.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Authority (HEA)
scholarships.coverage_en: Stipend EUR 10,000 for one year plus a full tuition fee waiver from the host institution.
scholarships.coverage_it: Stipendio 10.000 EUR per un anno + esenzione totale delle tasse dall'ateneo ospitante.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Non-EU/EEA students for one year of full-time study at NFQ level 9 or 10.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti extra-UE/SEE per un anno a tempo pieno a livello NFQ 9 o 10 (master/dottorato).

scholarships.name: Stefan Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
scholarships.provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
scholarships.coverage_en: Monthly stipend PLN 2,500, tuition exemption at public universities, preparatory course (Polish track), travel allowance PLN 2,500.
scholarships.coverage_it: Stipendio PLN 2.500/mese, esenzione tasse negli atenei pubblici, corso preparatorio, viaggio PLN 2.500.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Citizens of 36 Polish Aid partner countries, for full-time master's in Polish or English.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Cittadini di 36 paesi partner dell'aiuto polacco, per master a tempo pieno in polacco o inglese.

scholarships.name: Government Scholarships for Developing Countries
scholarships.provider: Czech Ministry of Education (MEYS)
scholarships.coverage_en: Scholarship for study at Czech public HEIs in Czech or English (master's and doctoral) under development cooperation.
scholarships.coverage_it: Borsa per studio in atenei pubblici cechi in ceco o inglese (master e dottorato) nella cooperazione allo sviluppo.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Citizens of a defined list of eligible developing countries for follow-up master's and doctoral programmes.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Cittadini di una lista definita di paesi in via di sviluppo per master e dottorati.

scholarships.name: Camoes Institute Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua
scholarships.coverage_en: Scholarships for Portuguese language/culture courses and, under bilateral cooperation, for higher education; paid monthly/quarterly by the Embassy.
scholarships.coverage_it: Borse per corsi di lingua/cultura portoghese e, nella cooperazione bilaterale, per l'alta formazione; pagate dall'Ambasciata.
scholarships.eligibility_en: Foreign students for Portuguese language/culture, and nationals of Portuguese-speaking African countries and East Timor under cooperation programmes.
scholarships.eligibility_it: Studenti stranieri per lingua/cultura, e cittadini dei PALOP e Timor Est nei programmi di cooperazione.
